name: Sushi Hana
notes: Official site sushihanasd.com/menu exists but the menu is a flat IMAGE with dish names/descriptions and NO prices. Uber Eats store (9869 Carmel Mountain Rd, matches OSM) has the full priced menu across ~12 categories. Verified $18.50 Lemon Salmon Roll on screen.

name: The Night & Day Cafe
notes: Official site coronadondcafe.com has a full HTML food menu (~71 items, 10 sections) but NO prices at all - only upcharges. Verified visually. Uber Eats (847 Orange Ave, Coronado) carries the same menu fully priced (delivery-inflated, e.g. Chocolate Chip Pancake $16.96). Tripadvisor lists in-house prices too.

name: Sushi MARU
notes: Reservation-only omakase counter at 1345 Third Ave (Cortez Hill). The official Menu page is prose, not a list: one 20-course omakase dinner at $180 per person plus optional sake pairing. Priced, but effectively a single-item menu - nothing dish-level to extract.

name: San Diego Burger Co.
notes: 879 W Harbor Dr Ste G, Seaport Village. Clean HTML menu with name + description + price for every item: Burgers 10, Specialty Burgers 6, Meatless 3, Hot Dogs 4, Fries/Rings 8, Kids 2 = 33 priced items (beverages listed unpriced). Site URL only findable via the Yelp listing - it does not rank on Google. Grubhub listing is dead ('not available anymore') and the Uber Eats store shows no prices while closed.

name: Chart House
notes: Landry's chain, 2588 S Coast Hwy 101, Cardiff. Location-specific HTML dinner menu (code chcf) with a price on every item: appetizers 12, soups+salads 5, Catch 4, chef feature 1, entrees 11, elevate/add-ons 7, sides 6 = ~47. A separate lunch menu (lunch-menu-chcf) adds more. Easiest and cleanest menu in the group.

name: Main Chick Hot Chicken
notes: 4705 Clairemont Dr Ste H. Official site eatmainchick.com/main-menu is a photo grid with 16 items and NO prices. The site's own ORDER ONLINE button goes to a DoorDash-powered white-label storefront (order.online) for the Clairemont store, which is fully priced - MC Sandwich $8.00, Combo 2 $16.50, Combo 4 $33.50 - across Combos, Salad, For The Flock, Single Items, Sides, Sauces, Desserts, Drinks. Also on Uber Eats and Grubhub.

name: Casa Nori Sushi
notes: 1730 E Palomar St, Chula Vista/Otay Ranch (OSM calls it Bonita). Official site casanorisushi.com/menu-2a offers five downloadable PDFs (Specials, Food, Happy Hour, Drinks, Platters). The Food PDF is 5 pages, dated 02.26.26, with a price on every line - Agadashi Tofu 10, Beef Sliders 16, Tonkotsu Ramen 16. PDF text-layer, not a scan. Also priced on Uber Eats and DoorDash.

name: San Marcos Deli
notes: 125 Vallecitos De Oro, San Marcos 92069 (OSM neighborhood label 'Rancho Santa Fe' is wrong). Single well-structured HTML menu page, name + description + price throughout: drinks/acai 6, breakfast 13, deli sandwiches 8, signature 7, club 3, hot sandwiches 12, wraps 6, salads+soups 12, sides/sweets 10 = 77. Also on Toast, DoorDash and Uber Eats.

name: Sushi Kyodai
notes: 12075 Carmel Mountain Rd Ste 205. Official site sushikyodai.com is a Wix one-pager with NO menu page at all (/menu is a 404) - just hours, contact and an Order Online button. That button goes to their own commission-free Foodbooking ordering system, which carries the entire menu fully priced across ~31 sections, roughly 240 items - by far the largest menu in this group. Not a marketplace, but not on their own domain either. Also on Uber Eats and Grubhub.

name: Dolci Cafe Italiano
notes: 2650 Jamacha Rd Ste 121 (listed as El Cajon / Rancho San Diego; OSM says Spring Valley). One /food-menu page with tabs for Brunch, Lunch, Dinner, Kids, Wine & Beer plus holiday menus. Every item priced in plain HTML - the Brunch tab alone has ~40 items (Smoked Salmon Benedict $17.00, Seafood Fettuccine $22.00). ~115 across all food tabs, estimated. Also has a VersiEats ordering page.
